integrity: All statements concern exact finite combinatorics and a proved lattice-local asymptotic; finite enumerations are supplementary. No external independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Identical positive unit valuations; nonempty complete allocations of exactly q goods per labeled agent on complete bipartite graphs, q>=3; count and asymptotic not generalized to heterogeneous valuations. The previously known star-factor center-count condition is not asserted as independently novel. Unindexed priority risk remains.
title: Arithmetic gaps and exponential scarcity of compact biclique allocations
